_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
description: Determines the goal for this manual
Void Termina - Final Episode Attack: Complete the heart spears to assemble the Star Allies Sparkler and defeat Void Termina.
Final Dimension - Happiest Curtain Call: Gather enough Friend Hearts to defeat the Retaliators and achieve a happy ending in Heroes in Another Dimension.
Soul Melter - Clear: Defeat Void Soul at the end of Soul Melter
Soul Melter EX - Clear: Defeat the Astral Birth at the end of Soul Melter EX

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Determines the goal for this manual
Void Termina - Final Episode Attack: Complete the heart spears to assemble the Star Allies Sparkler and defeat Void Termina.
Final Dimension - Happiest Curtain Call: Gather enough Friend Hearts to defeat the Retaliators and achieve a happy ending in Heroes in Another Dimension.
Soul Melter - Clear: Defeat Void Soul at the end of Soul Melter
Soul Melter EX - Clear: Defeat the Astral Birth at the end of Soul Melter EX
How many Heart Spear Pieces will be required to complete each Heart Spear?
Since there are four Heart Spears in total, the world will generate at least 4 times this amount.
How many additional Heart Spear Pieces will be generated?
How many Friend Hearts will be required to befriend The Three Mage-Sisters?
How many additional Friend Hearts will be generated?
How many additional Ultimate Spice Level UPs will be generated?
Nine are generated automatically for each level of the Ultimate Choice.
If you plan to challenge Soul Melter EX, you will need the three Extraordinary Components in addition to the nine default spice levels.
How many Allies/Copy Abilities should you start with?
Should Meta Knight and King Dedede be unlocked by befriending them after their respective boss fights?
Takes effect regardless of how other allies are unlocked.
How many duplicates of each copy ability should be added to the item pool?
How many duplicates of each dream friend should be added to the item pool?
Should allies be unlocked by collecting Friend Hearts?
If set to false, allies will be shuffled with the rest of the item pool.
What percentage of required Friend Hearts should be collected to unlock every ally?
May be set to a percent value higher than 100 in case you wish to factor in the extra Friend Hearts
(be wary of both required and extra amounts to avoid generation issues)
(if unsure, keep this value at 100 or lower)
If allies are locked behind Friend Hearts, should The Three Mage Sisters be the last ally you unlock?
Ignored if 'unify_magesisters' is set to true.
How many stages should you start with?
Should each of the seven moons in Far-Flung Starlight Heroes be locked behind clearing their respective planets?
Should EX Stages be locked behind their respective Big Switches?
How many duplicates of each stage should be added to the item pool?
Will the common picture pieces found in levels have checks?
Does not apply to any pieces that are RNG dependent.
Will the extra life items have checks?
Does not apply to any lives that are RNG dependent.
Will blue point stars have checks?
Does not apply to any stars that are RNG dependent.
Should Heroes in Another Dimension have any checks?
Note that if your goal involves befriending the Mage-Sisters, you will still need to clear Dimension V.
How should Dimensions I-IV be unlocked?
no_gating: The dimensions are fully accessible from the start. Note that if ally restrictions are enabled, this option behaves identically to 'ally_item'.
ally_item: Dimensions are always accessible, but in order to progress, you'll need to find the ability/dream friend that corresponds to each door.
stage_item: Each of the four dimensions will be shuffled into the item pool with all the other stages.
spear_gating: Each dimension is locked behind acquiring its respective friend action from each Heart Spear.
Should Heroes in Another Dimension be bound to the same available allies as the rest of the game?
If enabled, know that this may lead to long stretches of finding the right allies across the avaliable dimensions in some rare cases.
To mitigtate this, Dimension V's lobby is always accessible. Only its bosses and end goal are locked behind the main collectibles.
As an additional requirement for achieving the Happiest Ending, should the four main dimensions be cleared first?
Should The Three Mage-Sisters be unlocked by befriending them after their boss fight in Dimension V?
Takes effect regardless of how other allies are unlocked.
Will the collectible Friend Hearts found in Heroes in Another Dimension have checks?
Will the Story Mode sanity options (1ups, pieces, etc.) apply to Heroes in Another Dimension?
Should bosses from the Ultimate Choice yield checks?
Note that if the goal involves Ultimate Choice, you will still need to defeat the specified end boss (Void Soul or Astral Birth Void).
